2022_239_jan_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) report for January 2022, carried on the Board of Education agenda for March 15, 2022, itemizes every district P-card charge posted under the journal entry description "JAN PCARD EXP" across 21 printed pages bearing the print date 3/10/2022. Each line records transaction date, merchant, budget unit, account code, transaction amount and any credit. The report closes with a subtotal of 151,826.30 in charges and 2,684.22 in credits, and states Total Expenses of 149,142.08. The single largest charge is 10,138.10 to C & G Publishing, coded to budget unit 101928282087400, account 3510.

**Spending patterns**
Amazon (AMZN MKTP US, AMAZON.COM) and Staples (STAPLS-prefixed) dominate the line count, with Target, Meijer, Kroger, Michaels, Lowe's, The Home Depot, Sam's Club, GFS, Demco, Scholastic and J.W. Instructional supplies post to account 5110; general supplies to 5990; office supplies to 5910; vehicle parts to 4120/4130; dues and fees to 7410; conference and travel to 3210/3220; postage to 3430; software and technology services to 3450/6410/6460.

**Fund groups represented**
General fund budget units beginning 101 predominate. Also present: 700- and 701-prefixed student activity units; 122-prefixed grant units including special education (122885) and 122883; 120315 and 120317; 529202 (with Comcast, Quill, CASAS and ASE charges); 531004 early-childhood units; 535070 and 535071 technology units; 530201 and 530212; and 419160225407500, which carries an ALIBABA.COM charge of 634.49 to account 6410.

**Credits**
The Credits column captures returns and refunds, the largest being 435.00 from READING RECO against 101425221320900 (account 3220), 341.05 from AMZN MKTP US against 101180222374100, 299.04 from AUTOZONE 437 against 101070127031200, 272.56 from AMZN MKTP US against 101070113350000, and 151.36 from AMZN MKTP US against 122883122231000. Oakland Schools credits of 80.00 and 120.00 post against 531004118000000, and two 15.00 credits against 122885221326000.
